title: Admitted Is Not Effective: Lessons from a Notary-Gated Retrospective Loop in an Agentic Pipeline
abstract: arXiv:2611.29727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic software development pipelines with frozen prompts can repeat the same mistakes across pull requests (PRs), yet ungoverned additions to instruction files grow without bound and do not generally improve task success. We present a retrospective loop for a four-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline in which a Retrospective agent proposes edits to learned rules every ten PRs and a Notary admits, merges, or rejects them while recording each decision in a provenance ledger. In a pre-registered study of 880 PRs on two Python repositories, the loop ran end to end and the Notary admitted 55 of 89 proposals, rejecting 8 that cited nonexistent evidence.   However, held-out review comments and hidden-test resolution did not improve after ten retrospectives. Tracing each step of the loop, we found that sparse review signal (0.45 comments/PR) left little to learn from and that rules admitted on their stated evidence did not show measurab

translated_title: 被采纳不等于有效：智能体流水线中公证人把关回溯循环的经验教训
translated_abstract: 具有冻结提示词的智能体软件开发流水线会在不同拉取请求中重复同样的错误，而对指令文件不加治理的追加内容会无限增长，且通常并不能提高任务成功率。我们为一个四阶段大语言模型（LLM）流水线提出了一个回溯循环：一个“回溯智能体”每十个PR对学习到的规则提出修改建议，一个“公证人”则负责采纳、合并或拒绝这些建议，并将每个决定记录在溯源账本中。在一项涵盖两个Python仓库共880个PR的预注册研究中，该循环完整地端到端运行，公证人采纳了89个提案中的55个，并拒绝了8个引用不存在证据的提案。然而，在十次回溯之后，留出的评审评论和隐藏测试的解决率均未改善。通过对循环每一步的追踪，我们发现稀疏的评审信号（每PR仅0.45条评论）使得可供学习的内容寥寥无几，而且基于其所述证据被采纳的规则并未表现出可测量的改进。
tldr: 尽管公证人把关的回溯循环能够有效治理智能体流水线中的规则更新（包括拒绝引用虚假证据的提案），但由于评审信号过于稀疏且被采纳的规则缺乏实际效果，流水线性能在十次回溯后并未改善，证明“被采纳”并不等于“有效”。
en_tdlr: A notary-gated retrospective loop can govern rule updates in an agentic pipeline—even rejecting proposals citing nonexistent evidence—yet admitted rules failed to improve task success due to sparse review signal, demonstrating that being "admitted" does not mean being "effective."
